comment: Pinned provenance for datasets/. Nothing under datasets/ is stored in this repo; git-submodule entries are gitlinks, the rest are refetched by scripts/fetch_datasets.sh.

datasets.name: Open-SWE-Traces
datasets.verified: revision resolves on the HF API and its file manifest matches the local tree
datasets.note: Not a submodule: the local copy is an hf snapshot_download with no .git. Refetching costs 18G.

datasets.name: ToolBench
datasets.verified: revision resolves on the HF API; repo root is exactly data.zip + reproduction_data.zip, matching the cached LFS metadata
datasets.post_fetch: unzip data.zip and reproduction_data.zip in place, then remove the archives
datasets.note: Not a submodule: hf snapshot_download, no .git, and the tracked tree is the unzipped form.

datasets.name: TRAIL
datasets.verified: repo exists on the HF API
datasets.note: No local revision was recorded at download time, so this one is UNPINNED - refetching gives you current main, not necessarily the bytes used here.

datasets.name: ha-ultimate
datasets.verified: commit recorded in the snapshot's own _meta.json (version 1.0.2)
datasets.note: A single skill directory extracted from the openclaw/skills monorepo, not a benchmark corpus.

local_copy.note: The ~40G working copy was moved out of the repo on 2026-08-31 to keep the checkout small. examples/toolbench was moved alongside it to ~/Agent-datasets/examples. Point tooling there, or refetch into datasets/ with scripts/fetch_datasets.sh.
